title: 5.5.2 Slingshot — Worked Example
description: Drag a ball back from a fixed anchor, release, and watch it launch.

steps.title: Read the example
steps.instructions: A DistanceJoint tethers the ball to an anchor. On mouse drag, we set ball.x/y; on release we let physics take over.
hints: Removing the joint on release lets the ball fly free.

steps.title: Increase snap strength
steps.instructions: Try joint.damping = 0.1 to make the tether snappier. Or remove the joint entirely and set ball.vel directly based on drag distance.

steps.title: Add targets
steps.instructions: Stack a few dynamic blocks and knock them over with the slingshot.

requirements.title: Uses a joint for the tether
